description: This file defines data structures, constants, classes, and helper functions for remote control key mapping and IR/RF database management within a remote action mapping plugin, particularly including controller info, IR key codes, flags, and IRDB status management.

classes.name: KeyGroupSrcInfo
classes.description: Holds information about key group sources for input, volume, mute, and power controls.

classes.name: RFKeyFlags
classes.description: Tracks which RF keys are set for particular control functions such as input, volume, mute, and power.

classes.name: KeyPresenceFlags
classes.description: Contains RFKeyFlags for TV and AVR to indicate presence of specific keys.

classes.name: IRRFDBCtrlrLoadProgress
classes.description: Tracks the read/load progress of IR/RF database slots for a controller.

classes.name: keyActionMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping between a key and its IR data for TV and AVR, plus key identifiers.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::RemoteActionMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class managing communication with the control manager (IARM) for device info, key mappings, and IR database management.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceID
methods.description: Retrieves the last used device ID and its remote type, supports, and 5-digit code support.

methods.name: getControllerByID
methods.description: Fetches controller info for a given device ID.

methods.name: setKeyActionMap
methods.description: Sets the key action mapping for a specified device.

methods.name: getKeyActionMap
methods.description: Retrieves the current key action map for a device.

methods.name: clearKeyActionMap
methods.description: Clears the key action map for a device and key.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCode
methods.description: Assigns a 5-digit code to a device, for TV or AVR control.

methods.name: setIRDBDownloadFlag
methods.description: Sets the download state of the IR/RF database for a device.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCodeFlags
methods.description: Sets flags related to the 5-digit codes for a device.

methods.name: cancelCodeDownload
methods.description: Cancels ongoing IR/RF code download for a device.

methods.name: getControllerLoadStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the load status of IR/RF databases on a controller.

methods.name: lookupRFKey
methods.description: Converts a key name to its RF key code.

methods.name: lookupKeyname
methods.description: Converts an RF key code to its key name.

methods.name: setDevicePower
methods.description: Sets power for a device using a key action map.

methods.name: clearDevicePower
methods.description: Clears power commands for a device and RF key code.
